name: Advanced HTML Export
description: Choose CSS and JavaScript templates to export HTML or copy source and rich text.
permission.read: Read the active Markdown note, including unsaved changes, when producing output.
permission.export: Save HTML only through a native save dialog opened by your export command.
permission.clipboard: Optionally write HTML source or rich text to the system clipboard when you choose Copy.
permission.images: Optionally embed local images from approved attachment folders.
configurationHelp: Keep CSS and JavaScript templates on this device and choose one when producing output.
configurationLoadFailed: The saved templates could not be loaded.
configurationLoadHelp: The original data has been kept. Check plugin storage and retry to avoid overwriting it.
settingsHelp: Open the export dialog to choose or manage templates, then save a file or copy. Templates do not change NoteGen or its regular exports.
noNote: Open a Markdown note to export it.
template.manageHelp: Choose a template to edit or delete, or create a new one. The default style cannot be modified or deleted.
template.name: Template name
template.defaultImmutable: The default style cannot be modified or deleted. Create a new template instead.
template.deleteQuestion: Delete the template “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
dialogDescription: Choose a template and produce output for the current note.
dialogHelp: Enter code without style or script tags. Each field accepts up to 10,000 characters.
cssHelp: Appended after the HTML defaults. Rich text keeps only styles that can be safely inlined.
javascriptHelp: Included only in HTML files and source, and runs when a browser opens the file. Rich text never includes or runs scripts.
clipboardPermissionHelp: Copy requires the optional clipboard write permission. Grant it in plugin management; exporting files still works without it.
outputHelp: HTML source contains the template CSS and JavaScript. Rich text preserves compatible formatting; the target app may filter styles or images.
savedWithWarnings: Exported {name} to HTML with {count} resource or rendering notices.
copiedWithWarnings: Copied {name} with {count} resource or rendering notices.
capabilityMissing: This NoteGen version lacks required HTML output capabilities.
capabilityHelp: Use desktop NoteGen 0.39.1 or later with plugin protocol 0.1.12 support.
error.stale: The note changed before output started. Retry to use its latest version.
error.editorBusy: Finish text composition before producing output.
error.permission: A required permission is missing or was revoked. Review plugin permissions and try again.
error.cancelled: Output stopped because the workspace or permission context changed. Open the note and try again.
error.platform: Advanced HTML export currently requires the desktop application.
error.quota: The output exceeds the host's resource limits. Reduce the note or embedded assets and try again.
error.timeout: HTML generation timed out. Please try again.
error.codeLimit: Enter code of up to 10,000 characters.
error.templateName: Enter a template name of up to 80 characters.
error.templateDuplicate: A template already has this name. Choose another name.
error.templateMissing: The template is unavailable. Choose one again.
error.templateCount: Up to 20 custom templates can be saved.
error.templateLimit: Templates exceed the 512 KiB total limit. Reduce the number of templates or code size.
warning.asset-not-embedded: An image or font could not be embedded. The result may still depend on its original resource.
warning.unsupported-content: Some content could not be rendered for HTML output.
warning.highlight-fallback: Some code blocks use plain text because syntax highlighting was unavailable.
warning.additional-warnings: Additional resource or content notices are not listed individually.
warning.rich-text-css-omitted: Some CSS cannot be safely converted into rich-text inline styles and was omitted.
warning.rich-text-math-fallback: Some formulas were converted to readable text in rich text.
warning.rich-text-script-omitted: Rich text does not include or run template JavaScript.
warning.rich-text-content-omitted: Some content could not be preserved as rich text and was downgraded.
